name: Medical Trust Hospital
summary: Medical Trust Hospital is a 750-bed multispeciality acute and critical care referral hospital in Kochi, operating since 1973. It has been NABH accredited since 2011.
highlights: 750-bed acute and critical care referral hospital
Runs its own nursing, physiotherapy and paramedical colleges
